_about: The new revisits and trips a change makes on purpose (node tools/polestar.js flow-diff; docs/ROUTE-FEEL.md "Flow diff"). Each row accepts one: `kind` "revisit" with the `guide` it happens in and the `zone` it goes back into, or "trip" with the `guide` and the `quest` (a one-quest trip) or the `step` title (a walk with nothing there). `reason` says why the route is better that way for players, on our own evidence. A pull request that adds a revisit or a trip adds its row here; rows sorted by guide.

allow.reason: #2419: the guide's last leg walks from Theramore through the Barrens' coast to Ratchet's boat to Booty Bay, where 30-40/04-stranglethorn-vale now starts. It replaces the boat to Menethil, the flight to Darkshire, the walk down Stranglethorn and back and the flight to Sentinel Hill: three revisits and three one-quest trips gone in 04, Stranglethorn's walk and fly 48.3/12.8 -> 37.4/7.4 min, the level model 13 minutes less to 60. A transfer with no work in the Barrens; recordings: 12 Alliance walks Theramore to Ratchet at 29-38, none with a death in Dustwallow.
